prompts.concept:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art videogame enemy character design sheet, 4 orthographic/three-quarter views on transparent background, no text.
Primary request: Design the basic enemy "water monkey automaton" for a restrained 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. A small agile clockwork MONKEY puppet with a clearly simian muzzle, circular ears, long articulated forearms, short bent hind legs and a single curved segmented tail. NOT a human robot. It has a sturdy compact body, roughly 2.5 heads tall, readable silhouette, ordinary-sized rather than boss-sized. Matte aged brass body plates, desaturated petrol teal armor, a small ivory muzzle and chest plate, dark graphite flexible joints, two small pale-cyan glass eyes. Simple clean readable pixel clusters, dark navy outline, 5 to 7 broad shade values, no noisy microdetail or glossy 3D rendering. Similar finish and silhouette readability to high-quality GBA tactical RPG character sprites.
Essential equipment: one compact water-bomb throwing cannon securely mounted HIGH ON ITS BACK behind the shoulders, consisting of a round teal water reservoir and a short upward-angled brass mortar barrel with a simple visible pivot. This is a BACK-MOUNTED machine, NOT a handheld gun, NOT a head hat, not a second face. Both hands remain empty for weak melee palm strikes. No swords, no fur, no clothing, no wings, no magic.
Layout: EXACTLY 2 columns x 2 rows with four equally-sized 512 x 512 cells in a 1024x1024 transparent square image. One complete full-body character centered in each cell, consistent apparent scale and anatomy. All limbs, cannon and entire curled tail inside each cell with at least 48 px transparent margin.
Top left: battle-ready three-quarter view facing LEFT, both hands hanging slightly forward, cannon visible on back to viewer right.
Top right: rear three-quarter view facing LEFT, clearly show the reservoir and cannon mounting.
Bottom left: direct front view, both feet visible.
Bottom right: direct back view, tail, reservoir and mortar mounting readable.
No scene, floor, shadow, labels, letters, numbers, checkerboard, grid lines, frame, watermark. True transparent alpha outside the four characters. This is a new enemy; preserve consistent identity and equipment across all four views.
prompts.battle:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent pixel-art animation keyframe sprite atlas for a fantasy tactical RPG.
Input image 1 is the approved-for-continuity DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY, not a sheet to preserve. Create new animation poses of exactly this small water-monkey clockwork puppet. Preserve the brass monkey muzzle, ears, pale cyan eyes, matte desaturated teal armor, long jointed empty arms, short hind legs, curled segmented tail and ONE round reservoir with short brass throwing mortar mounted on the BACK. Clean crisp controlled pixel clusters and dark outlines. No extra weapons or magic, no fur.
EXACT LAYOUT: 4 columns x 5 rows, 20 equal cells, portrait canvas. Every character cell contains ONE complete character facing LEFT in side/three-quarter view, head and body consistent scale across all 16 character poses, full tail and cannon uncut, at least 15 percent empty padding at all cell edges. Keep character foot baseline consistent. Background true transparent. No text, numbers, labels, grid lines, floor, shadow or watermark.
ROW 1, left to right, WEAK MELEE PALM STRIKE: (1) relaxed battle idle crouch, (2) draw near empty palm back with slightly bent knees, (3) extend that palm strongly LEFT at chest height while the far hand remains at body, (4) draw palm back to crouch. Only ONE striking hand, no combo, cannon stays passive.
ROW 2, WATER-BOMB CANNON: (1) crouch lower and brace both empty hands against ground, (2) back-mounted mortar tilts LEFT/up toward target, (3) mortar fires with ONE small pale-blue water droplet at muzzle, (4) recoil bends mount backward then body begins recovering. Monkey itself does not throw by hand. Keep cannon on BACK in all frames.
ROW 3, DAMAGE AND PART BREAK: (1) flinch backward from ordinary hit, (2) recoil while a visible crack opens on the back mortar barrel, (3) broken back mortar barrel angled downward, short blue leak from cracked reservoir but NO explosion or extra attack, (4) resume active crouch with broken nonfunctional cannon still hanging on the back. Body remains alive and hands intact.
ROW 4, ESCAPE AND DEFEAT: (1) lean LEFT and start running, (2) left foot forward/right foot back with opposite arm swing, (3) right foot forward/left foot back with opposite arm swing, (4) defeated monkey collapsed on side on ground, no blood. Three running poses keep fixed back equipment and tail identity.
ROW 5, FOUR SMALL SEPARATE EFFECT SPRITES, NO CHARACTER: (1) one round blue water bomb in flight with very short trail, (2) initial water impact burst, (3) broad low splash spreading, (4) final small scattered drops. Entire effect in each cell with big transparent margins. No flames, sparks, shockwave, smoke, or extra bombs.
Make each cell visually separated by transparent empty space, exact regular grid, no overlap into adjacent cells. Animation poses must have real articulated limb changes, not just translations of the idle sprite.
prompts.maps:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent TOP-DOWN TACTICAL MAP sprite sheet, 16 new articulated walking poses.
Input image 1 is the water-monkey automaton DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY. Keep exactly the same enemy identity and colors: matte brass monkey head with round ears and short ivory muzzle, pale cyan eyes, desaturated teal armor, long empty jointed forearms, short hind legs, one curled segmented tail, one round teal reservoir and short brass mortar mounted high on BACK. Do not copy the large detailed illustration style. These are compact clean 16-bit tactical-RPG MAP SPRITES, like GBA overworld sprites, viewed slightly from above, large readable pixel clusters, simplified features, dark navy outline, no anti-alias fuzz, no subpixel details, no shading gradients.
EXACT REGULAR GRID: 4 columns x 4 rows in a square transparent canvas, equal square cells. One FULL BODY sprite per cell, consistent apparent scale, plenty of empty transparent space between all characters. Every sprite should occupy at most 65 percent of cell width and height. Fixed foot baseline within each row. No labels, text, numbers, frame, grid, floor, shadow, checkerboard, watermark.
ROW 1: walking DOWN / facing viewer. Columns: left foot forward and opposite right arm forward; both feet underneath; right foot forward and opposite left arm forward; both feet underneath. Face with two eyes, cannon behind head/shoulders, not covering face.
ROW 2: walking RIGHT / true side profile. Columns: far leg forward and near leg back; feet together; near leg forward and far leg back; feet together. Muzzle faces right, one side eye, curved tail and cannon behind torso to left.
ROW 3: walking UP / back view. Columns: left foot forward; feet together; right foot forward; feet together. Back reservoir prominently visible, back of round ears, no eyes visible from rear, curved tail below back.
ROW 4: walking LEFT / true side profile. Columns: far leg forward and near leg back; feet together; near leg forward and far leg back; feet together. Muzzle faces left, one side eye, curved tail and cannon behind torso to right.
Real alternating leg and opposite-arm poses, NOT copies shifted around. Keep head shape, muzzle, arms length, tank, cannon attachment, brass and teal markings consistent across all sixteen cells. Cannon must be INTACT in every map frame. No projectiles, no water leaks. Clear separation of hands and feet, precisely one tail per monkey.
prompts.broken_battle:
Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent pixel-art character animation atlas, 4 columns by 3 rows, twelve equal cells. Reference image shows the SAME brass-and-teal water-monkey automaton in different poses. Create a NEW set of poses of this SAME character with its BACK CANNON PERMANENTLY BROKEN in EVERY cell: mortar barrel bent downward, visibly cracked pivot, one small cyan drip at reservoir. Body remains alive, both empty hands work normally. Preserve monkey face, round ears, ivory muzzle, cyan eyes, long forearms, short legs and one curved segmented tail. All complete characters face LEFT, consistent scale and foot baseline, at least 15% transparent padding. Crisp readable pixel clusters with restrained matte shading, dark navy outline.
Row 1: relaxed crouching idle; prepare a weak empty-palm strike; extend ONE empty palm left at chest height for single hit; retract palm and recover.
Row 2: lean back reacting to hit; crouch recovering from hit; fall onto side with damaged cannon still attached; fully collapsed defeated body.
Row 3: lean left preparing to run; run left with left foot forward and opposite right arm forward; run left with right foot forward and opposite left arm forward; stop in a low crouch after running.
Damage is confined to the back cannon; do not add body wounds. No intact cannon anywhere, no firing, no water bombs, no explosions, no sparks, no blood. Both hands empty. One monkey per cell, exactly regular 4x3 grid, true transparent outside characters. No text, numbers, grid lines, ground, shadow or watermark.
prompts.broken_maps:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided 4x4 transparent pixel-art water-monkey map sprite sheet. Make the BACK CANNON BROKEN in all sixteen sprites: a short brass barrel bent DOWN, a cracked mounting, and one tiny cyan drip. Preserve every monkey's existing head, muzzle, ears, body, hand and leg pose, curled tail, teal and brass colors, pixel-art style, scale and cell position. Body remains alive and mobile.
Keep the EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows layout: row1 walking DOWN/front; row2 RIGHT/side; row3 UP/back; row4 LEFT/side. Keep the same alternating stepping poses and regular transparent space between cells. All sixteen cannons must be consistently broken, no intact mortar barrel pointing upward anywhere. In front view the damaged cannon stays behind the shoulder, never over the face. No projectiles or explosions. True clean transparent background, remove faint gray haze, no floor, shadows, text, labels, grid lines or watermark.

failures: Two broken-map image-generation calls had connection failures; retried successfully. No API fallback used.

prompts.run:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel-art tactical RPG battle RUNNING keyframe sheet, 4 columns by 2 rows, eight equal cells, true transparent background.
Input image 1 is the design reference for the brass and muted teal water-monkey automaton. Input image 2 is the broken-cannon version of the same character. Create NEW RUNNING poses, not edits to the existing atlas layout.
Every complete monkey faces LEFT in the same three-quarter side view. Keep identical head size, torso size, limb proportions and foot baseline in all eight cells. Small agile mechanical monkey with round ears, ivory short muzzle, pale cyan eyes, long EMPTY articulated forearms, short bent hind legs, one curled segmented tail, and ONE back-mounted round teal tank with brass mortar. Dark navy outline, controlled matte pixel clusters, restrained brass/teal colors, no new equipment, no fur.
TOP ROW: four running phases with the cannon INTACT and pointing upward-left from the BACK. Columns: (1) near leg reaches left, far leg back and opposite arm forward; (2) low contact step with legs passing; (3) far leg reaches left, near leg back and opposite arm forward; (4) low passing step. Maintain low monkey posture but do NOT shrink the head or body on passing steps. Visible real leg and arm articulation.
BOTTOM ROW: the SAME four running phases, same body size, with the back cannon BROKEN, barrel bent downward, cracked pivot and a small cyan leak. The monkey body remains active and undamaged. No intact cannon in this row.
Consistent scale: body from top of head to feet has the SAME height in both rows; an intact barrel may extend above the head, a broken barrel need not. Feet at the same local ground line; small natural one-pixel vertical running bounce only. Keep all arms, feet, tail and cannon inside their cells, with at least 15 percent empty margin. EXACT 4x2 regular grid, no overlapping cells, no motion trails, no projectiles, no flames, no floor, no shadow, no text, labels, numbers or grid lines.
prompts.water_final:
Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent 16-bit PIXEL ART water-cannon game effects sprite atlas. EXACTLY 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal square cells in 1024x1024.
Extremely important EMPTY MARGINS: each entire effect must fit within the CENTER 60 percent of its cell width AND height, with at least 20 percent clean transparent padding on EACH of all four sides. NO WATER OR PARTICLES MAY TOUCH A CELL EDGE OR THE CANVAS EDGE. Do not enlarge effects to fill cells. One full isolated effect per cell, centered. No background or grid.
Top left: thick powerful water-cannon jet flying LEFT. Dense blue water mass, broad blunt foamy leading head on LEFT, heavy connected flowing water wake trailing RIGHT. About 2.5 times as wide as tall. Clearly a coherent pressurized water cannon shot, NOT a raindrop. Rounded taper at the trailing end, full outline visible.
Top right: same-sized second flight phase of that thick leftward water jet with changed internal foam ribbons and a slightly different crest, complete rounded trailing end.
Bottom left: one forceful tall water impact splash as the cannon hits a single target, white foamy crest, heavy coherent blue water volume and lower splash crown. Entire splash including all lobes inside center area.
Bottom right: later lower settling water splash, heavy connected water ribbons spreading to both sides and falling, every tip inside center area.
Pale cyan and middle blue with dark blue shadows and white foam, crisp clear pixel clusters, restrained game sprite finish. No glowing aura, no magic, no fire, no ice, no bullets, no teardrop silhouette. No tiny disconnected particle cloud or hazy alpha spray. No characters, ground, shadow, text, labels, numbers, frame or watermark. True transparency outside the four effects.
